While not exclusively vegan or plant-based, they do offer a range of vegetarian recipes and tips for incorporating more plant-based meals into your diet. Their blog also covers Jewish food traditions and holidays.

feeds.title: Keralaslive
feeds.description: A modern Indian food blog by Chef Sumith Babu with healthy foods. A destination for tried and tested recipes with videos.

feeds.title: Searching for Spice
feeds.description: Searching for Spice is my food blog which I have been writing since 2010. I love cooking, reading and writing about food and began Searching for Spice as a way of recording some of my favourite recipes and to have a place where I could easily find my favourite dishes when I wanted to make them again. A blog by Corina.

feeds.title: Sharking for chips and drinks...
feeds.description: London's leading food, drink and travel online guide with contributors covering all things culinary in Asia and Australia.

feeds.title: Easy Peasy Lemon Squeezy - Easy Recipes & Lifestyle Blog
feeds.description: Easy Lovable Recipes, Food, Cocktails, Lifestyles, Laughs & lemons - Easy peasy lemon squeezy blogging easy recipes and lots of laughs for everyday life.

feeds.title: Good Nude Food
feeds.description: Good Nude Food is a Scottish health food company dedicated to creating delicious, live fermented foods that are good for you!

feeds.title: The Bearded Bakery
feeds.description: The Bearded Bakery is a a blog specialised in male lifestyle, baking and travelling through the eyes of a London based man.

feeds.title: Kerry Cooks
feeds.description: Swoon-worthy bakes, how-to's, & lovely stuff from nutella-addicted food and lifestyle blogger. Author of the first and most popular UK Rainbow Cake recipe! This blog contains recipes and inspiration from the sweeter side of life.
